text.description_html:
First Impressions FII-CFRBAF-AE Frosted Acrylic Appliance Pull

Made in the USA by the master craftsmen at First Impressions from the finest frosted acrylic available. The acrylic is manufacture with UV inhibitors to prevent yellowing and fading. The angled ends add that extra level of styling. Satin Nickel mounting brackets.

Packaged with mounting screws for a refrigerator or other appliance door panel.

Specifications for First Impressions FII-CFRBAF-AE Frosted Acrylic Appliance Pull

  • Pull Handle Diameter: 1-1/8"
  • Total Projection: 2-3/4"
  • 45 Degree Angle Cut Ends
  • Pull Handle Material: Frosted Acrylic
  • Pull Bracket Material: Solid Brass
  • Bracket Finish: Satin Nickel

Available Standard Lengths

  • FII-CFRBAF-AE-12 - Total Length: 12" : Center to Center Mount: 7-15/16"
  • FII-CFRBAF-AE-24 - Total Length: 24" : Center to Center Mount: 18"

Note: This appliance handle is handmade in the USA when you order it—allowing it to be custom designed to fit your specific door application, including Other Lengths and Finishes. Unfortunately, because of the made-to-order nature of the appliance handle, it is Not Returnable. Please Contact Us with your requirements or if you have any questions.

Packaged with mounting screws for a standard 3/4" thick refrigerator/appliance door panel.

Sold individually.

Special Edition. Limited Quantities Available. Order Now.
